question: Which musician is associated with the musical instrument, the Mridangam?
solution:
The correct answer is __**KV Prasad**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• K. V. Krishna Prasad

 
 
• **K. V. Krishna Prasad**, otherwise called KP, is a Carnatic music singer and is a famous Mridangam artist.
 
• He breezed through his Music Seniors Test with college third position.
 
• He has composed a book** "Na kanda GurugaLu" **in Kannada distributed by Kannada Sahitya Parishat.
 
• He has additionally performed abroad in the Singapore Expressive arts (SIFA)**, Los Angeles, San Jose, San Francisco, New York, and as of late the lofty AKKA Sammelana.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **RK Bijapure Awards and recognitions**

 
 
• 1985 - "Karnataka Kala Tilak" by Sangeet Nritya Foundation.
 
 
 
• ​**Zakir Hussain Awards and accolades**
 
 
• Zakir Hussain was awarded the titles of Padma Shri in 1988, and Padma Bhushan in 2002.
 
• Recipient of the Kalidas Samman in 2006, an award for artists of exceptional achievement, from the Government of Madhya Pradesh.
 
 
 
• **Ali Akbar Khan Awards**
 
 
• The Padma Vibhushan in 1989.
 
• Khan was granted the Padma Bhushan in 1967.
